scope: One bounded two-account trial on one Windows host using retained sessions and relay-only native helpers
diagnosticChange: A bounded terminal snapshot now preserves only signaling flags/counters and native phase/reason/readiness booleans before cleanup; no credentials, SDP or ICE addresses
officialFlowDifference: Official receiver emits its offer upon config before explicit accept; laboratory currently emits accept then offer. Both laboratory peers negotiated in this trial, so this order difference is not established as the cause of ICE failure.
privacy: No user identifiers, phone numbers, tokens, OTPs, public/private certificates, SDP, ICE addresses or raw replies are included
